name: Triens
status: in force since 2026-09-22 — rules-only paper index, no vault and no capital; inception anchored (see decisions.jsonl, 2026-09-22-triens-paper-inception). The working-capital sleeve is a T-bill proxy (DTB3) until a fully-reserved fiat-backed stable exists on GIWA.

source.rulebook: quadrix/docs/methodology/triens.md (site repo, private) — draft of 2026-09-21 with the owner's evening decisions D1-D5, D10, D11, D13, D15 applied
source.backtestHarness: quadrix/docs/research/qquality/qquality-backtest.py (eligible(): the Quality screen; sleeve_weights(): net-revenue weighting) with quadrix/docs/research/barbell/barbell_common.py (simulate_p2, cash_step)
source.sharedRulebook: quadrix/docs/methodology/value-capture.md (qREV) — the Quality sleeve inherits its universe definition, exclusions, value-trap filter, rank buffer, hysteresis, floor and cap from it
source.note: This file is the implemented parameter set; the prose rulebook is the narrative record of why. Where the two differ the prose rulebook governs and this file is wrong and should be fixed.

monetary.rule: fixed list, not a screen. BTC alone (triens.md §1, D5). A change to the list is a rule change (decision document, anchor, no retroactive effect).
monetary.note: the BTC+ETH variant was behind in every window tested and the owner's ratio table is on a BTC-only basis.

workingCapital.rule: fiat-backed stablecoins, fully reserved in cash and short Treasuries, issuer attestation published, canonical on the settlement chain. Interest-bearing forms ARE allowed (owner 2026-09-21, D10). Partially-reserved, synthetic and crypto-collateralised forms are not.
workingCapital.nameListStatus: open — the list itself is an anchored decision (D10-b) and cannot be written yet: no fiat-backed stablecoin is canonical on GIWA (미확인, triens.md §12-6).

paperProxy.what: a synthetic $1 unit accruing the 3-month Treasury bill rate daily: unitValue *= (1 + r/100)^(1/365) per calendar day, r = FRED DTB3, last published print carried forward on days with no print
paperProxy.source: FRED DTB3 (3-Month Treasury Bill, Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis, percent p.a.), https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DTB3
paperProxy.why: the sleeve's real assets do not exist on chain yet, so the paper record cannot hold them. The backtest ran the sleeve at the T-bill rate (barbell_common.py cash_step, mode 'tbill'); the paper record uses the same assumption rather than a zero-yield dollar, and stamps `wcProxy: "DTB3"` on every record line so the level is never mistaken for a held asset.
paperProxy.notModelled: issuer spread, redemption risk, depeg, and any on-chain yield that is not the bill.

depeg.rule: a held stablecoin quoted below $0.98 for 72 consecutive hours on two price sources is replaced at the next run by the next name on the decision list; if there is no replacement the position is held and the event is recorded in a decision document
depeg.status: draft threshold (triens.md D17) — no measurement behind $0.98 or 72h
depeg.implementedNote: not implemented in the keeper: the paper record holds the DTB3 proxy, which has no peg to break.

quality.rule: the screen below, net-revenue weighted, capped at 35% WITHIN the sleeve (10.5% of the whole index)

emptySeats.rule: each of the N seats is 1/N of the sleeve. If fewer than N names pass the screen, each empty seat's 1/N of the sleeve goes to the working-capital sleeve — not to BTC (owner 2026-09-21, D4)
emptySeats.note: the BTC variant produced higher multiples but made the product 70-80% BTC for most of the backtest, which is a different product than the one the name describes.

universe.definition: the qREV universe: protocol tokens with a DefiLlama dailyHoldersRevenue adapter (manual map, no automatic name matching), plus chain-native tokens whose trailing-12-month burn exceeds the value of new issuance over the same period (netBurn12m > 0)
universe.protocolMap: keeper/rulebooks/qrev-protocol-map.json — the same manual table qREV uses, read by the same code
universe.monetaryExcluded: BTC and ETH are monetary assets and never enter the Quality sleeve (triens.md §3)

exclusions.assetTypeExclusions: qREV §3 in full: stablecoins, yield-bearing stables, wrapped assets, liquid-staking derivatives, LP shares, off-chain-promise exchange tokens (OKB, CRO, LEO), tokenized RWA shares. BNB is a chain token (net-burn rule), not an exchange token.
exclusions.gamblingAdapters: included in the per-protocol sum, inherited from qREV D4
exclusions.chainsOpen: whether a net-burn chain counts as 'productive' at all is open (triens.md D12); the draft includes them and the backtest ran chains='netburn'

valueTrapFilter.description: trailing-30-day holder revenue must be at least this fraction of the trailing-12m monthly average

issuanceGate.rule: trailing-12-month issuance value / trailing-12-month holder revenue <= theta. This is a GATE here, not a weighting adjustment — that is the difference from qREV, where the same number nets the weight and a diluting name simply falls to the floor weight.
issuanceGate.unknownIssuanceNote: a token whose issuance cannot be measured (no supply a year earlier: listed under a year in the registry's reach, or an id migration) FAILS the gate (triens.md §2, D7). Passing it would be waving A-1 through unverified.
issuanceGate.chainTokens: a chain token's revenue is already net of issuance by construction (netBurn12m), so the netBurn12m > 0 universe test IS its issuance gate; the ratio is not computed twice. Same treatment as qquality-backtest.py eligible() under chains='netburn'.
issuanceGate.source: owner 2026-09-21 (D3). theta 0.5 left the sleeve unable to fill its seats (median 2 names); theta 2 and no gate at all were behind over the 2024-> window.

ranking.metric: net revenue = trailing-12m holder revenue - trailing-12m issuance value (chain tokens: netBurn12m)
ranking.note: NO valuation ranking. 'Is it cheap' is the discretionary layer of the managed product (owner 2026-09-02), not a screen — this is the visible difference from qREV, which ranks by P/HR ascending.

rankBuffer.note: floor(0.85 N) to enter, ceil(1.25 N) to stay — the same buffer shape as qREV at N = 10. Ranking has not yet bitten in any tested quarter (eligible <= 10).

exitHysteresis.description: an incumbent that fails a gate or falls outside the exit rank is kept one further quarter, flagged onNotice, and removed only on a second consecutive failure (qREV §6, triens.md §6)

weighting.netRevenueFormula: netRevenue_i = holderRevenue12m_i - issuanceValue12m_i (chain tokens: netBurn12m_i, already net)

floor.note: floor = 2% of the sum of POSITIVE net revenues in the sleeve, recomputed at each reconstitution; a name below it is weighted at the floor, never dropped by this rule alone

weighting.allNegativeFallback: if every member's net revenue is <= 0 in a quarter, that quarter falls back to gross trailing-12m holder-revenue weighting (qREV §4)

cap.scope: within the quality sleeve — 10.5% of the whole index
cap.method: immediate trim at reconstitution, excess redistributed pro rata among uncapped names, iterated to convergence (the same applyCap as qREV and keeper/update-nav.mjs). No drift corridor above the cap; a cap breach is always cut regardless of the reconstitution tolerance.

issuance.definition: on-chain total supply minus balances of protocol-controlled addresses listed in keeper/supply/registry.json; voluntary lockups (vote-escrow) count as issued
issuance.primarySource: keeper/supply/registry.json + keeper/supply/supply-weekly.json (the same on-chain measurement qREV reads, read by the same code)
issuance.fallbackSource: CoinGecko circulating supply now vs ~365 days ago (coins/{id}/history, market_cap / price as the supply proxy)
issuance.fallbackFlag: issuanceSource: "coingecko" is stamped on that member's record row whenever the fallback is used
issuance.openQuestion: SKY's issuance source is not yet unified between the registry's composite series and CMC (triens.md D9, open) — the keeper reads whatever the shared registry gives it, exactly as qREV does
issuance.censusStatusRule: A symbol whose registry entry carries census_status "incomplete" is not measured from the registry; it falls back to the market-data supply series and the row says so (see the same note in qrev.json — one shared code path). Owner 2026-09-22. This matters more here than in qREV: the same number is a GATE in this product, not a weight adjustment. LINK on 2026-09-21 is the case that surfaced it — issuance 0 and the gate passed before the fix, ratio 14.99 and the gate fails after it, which is the rulebook appendix's own 15.0.

reconstitution.rule: first run after 00:00 UTC on Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1 — the same day as qREV and qDEFI
reconstitution.resetTo: the sleeve target weights above (30 / 40 / 30), adjusted for empty seats

tolerance.scope: sleeve, and separately within the quality sleeve per name
tolerance.rule: if EVERY sleeve's drifted weight is within 5 percentage points of its target, no value moves between sleeves; otherwise every sleeve is reset to target. Inside the quality sleeve the same 5-point rule applies per name against its sleeve-internal weight, with the cap override: a name drifted above 35% of the sleeve is always cut.
tolerance.divergenceFromBacktest: the P2 grid reset the three sleeve weights exactly every quarter (barbell_common.py simulate_p2) — no sleeve tolerance — while the Quality sleeve's own engine applied the 5-point tolerance to whole-portfolio name weights (qquality-backtest.py run(), tol=0.05). Reading the rulebook's "5%p" as a sleeve-level no-trade band plus a name-level band inside the sleeve is this keeper's reading of §6, and it is the one place where the implementation had to choose. Flagged, not settled.

reconstitution.betweenReconstitutions: no trading, no drift band. Interest accrued in the working-capital sleeve stays in that sleeve and is redistributed only at the quarterly reset — which is what the backtest did (weekly accrual, quarterly reset).

driftBand.note: no drift band (triens.md §7), same conclusion as qREV and qDEFI. Do not re-propose.

overlay.note: no trend or volatility overlay (triens.md §7, D11: "index line — not allowed"). The overlay grid never beat the fixed ratio consistently and ran two to three times the turnover.

holderRevenue.primary: DefiLlama summary/fees/{slug}?dataType=dailyHoldersRevenue, per slug from the manual map
holderRevenue.fallback: none — a protocol whose every adapter fetch fails is dropped from that day's candidate list, not zero-filled

marketCapPriceVolume.fallback: CoinPaprika tickers (price only, cannot drive a reconstitution)

btcPrice.fallback: CoinPaprika, then the last known price for at most 3 consecutive runs (qX20 §9); after that the run fails

supplyIssuance.fallback: CoinGecko circulating supply, current vs ~365 days ago

workingCapitalRate.fallback: the most recent cached copy of the same series; no second source

specialEvents.note: migrations, hacks and delistings are out of scope for this implementation pass, as for qREV/qDEFI. The rulebook's §9 triggers (-40% vs BTC with TVL -50%, control-address drain, price loss) are written down there and not implemented here.

fees.decision: owner 2026-09-22 (triens.md D19): 1% per year streaming, the same value as qREV and qDEFI, no performance fee, redemption fee permanently prohibited. The launch value is a permanent ceiling — the contract accepts reductions only.
fees.note: the paper level is GROSS, like qREV's and qDEFI's. Cost disclosure is a separate net-of-fee row in the research (net_multiple_1), not a second level in this record.

viability.note: below five eligible names the product is not made at all (triens.md §12-1, draft value D18). The paper record still computes a level — it is a record of what the rule would have done, including the quarters where the rule says don't ship — and the seat count is on every record line.

basket._doc: No basket vault exists for this index and none can be deployed while GIWA carries no canonical BTC (triens.md §12-5). vault null = the keeper computes every mark and posts nothing.
